projectDescription: A browser-based fake stock market simulator game where players buy and sell SILVER stock in real time using candlestick charts.
keyFeatures: Real-time candlestick chart with live price updates every second
Buy and sell SILVER stock shares using on-screen buttons or keyboard shortcuts
Dynamic portfolio tracker showing cash, shares held, and net worth
Random price spikes and drops for unpredictable market simulation
Live price indicator line showing the current market price at a glance
Active developing candlestick block preview in real time
Keyboard shortcuts: B to Buy, S to Sell, Q to Quit
publicApiSurface: buy_share() — purchases one share at the current market price
sell_share() — sells one share at the current market price
MarketSimulation.tick_micro_price() — advances the price simulation by one frame
MarketSimulation.finalize_block() — closes the current candlestick and starts a new one
Click: BUY button, SELL button on canvas
